title: Methodology-Level Audit Gap: Named Deferrals (FF1 + FF3)
summary: FF1 (practitioner-originated framing absorption) and FF3 (Essay-Outline amendment re-audit protocol) are recognized at vocabulary level with two-direction graduation triggers (harm evidence or reliance evidence over two to four cycles); the structural amendments are deferred.
mechanism: named deferral with two-direction graduation trigger

links.note: the graduation-trigger element applied to a deferral rather than a mechanism
Three-Application F-P2 Pattern thread; applies ADR-097's filter reflexively to its own scope choice
